meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用自动实验把模型或流程的评分逐步顶高
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常为模型或流程的分数头疼,想用自动实验挑出更稳妥的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run experiments to push model or pipeline scores steadily higher
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need automatic experiments to improve a model or pipeline and avoid overfitting.

howto.what: Claude 会自主跑多轮实验来改进你指定的产物:把研究状态存进一棵假设树,派子代理在隔离的 git worktree 里各测一个假设,只有通过留出测试评估器的改动才合并成新版本。
howto.when: 当你要反复实验来优化某个具体产物(如提高模型评测分、改进 agent harness、跑 Kaggle 式优化),或描述「跑实验—评估」的重复循环时接管;用户没说“Arbor”也触发。

say.text: 帮我把这个模型的评测分提上去,用 arbor 跑一轮优化
say.note: 会先确认目标、开发与测试评估器再开始搜索

say.text: 改进这个 agent harness 的通过率,目标设为最大化准确率
say.note: 假设记进树,最好版本留在某个分支上

say.text: 并行测这几个假设,只把通过测试门槛的那个合并
say.note: 各假设在独立 worktree 跑;只有过测试门槛的才合并

howto.what_en: Claude runs an autonomous optimization loop on an artifact: it stores research state in a hypothesis tree, sends subagents to test one hypothesis each in git worktrees, and merges a change only if it passes a held-out test evaluator.
howto.when_en: It takes over when you want to iteratively improve a concrete artifact under a scorer — e.g. raise a model's eval score, improve an agent harness, or run a Kaggle-style task.

say_en.text: Help me raise this model's eval score — run an arbor optimization
say_en.note: It pins down the objective, dev and test evaluators first

say_en.text: Improve this agent harness's pass rate; set the objective to maximize accuracy
say_en.note: Hypotheses go in a tree; the best artifact stays on a branch

say_en.text: Test these hypotheses in parallel worktrees, then merge the one that passes
say_en.note: Each runs in its own worktree; only test-gate winners merge
